goal: Rebuild the real pipeline overview with execution summary, step status, duration, environment, explicit image availability, and current step-log routing without changing APIs or task 3.3 log behavior.
non_goals: Do not parse YAML, add dependencies, change the step/API/backend contract, or invent image, queue, resource, agent, release, annotation, or artifact data.
Do not redesign the PipelineLog console or changed-files/config/errors/debug bodies owned by task 3.3.
Do not modify PipelineWrapper header actions, router, API client, store, authentication, permissions, backend, persistence, dependencies, or the approved prototype.
expected_evidence: Focused red/green component tests for overview defaults, real summary/context, image fallback/config entry, log routing, empty/error states, and approval/decline behavior.
Full frontend Vitest, targeted Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript, Vite build, and git diff output.
Targeted desktop and 390px browser evidence for overview and selected-log states in dark Simplified Chinese plus representative light/English and read-only permission.
Evidence-bearing task report plus independent A2/A3/A4 spec and quality reviews.
unsafe_assumptions: The persisted/API PipelineStep does not expose the executor image, so missing image must be explicit rather than inferred.
Historical config order and arbitrary YAML syntax cannot be safely mapped to persisted step PIDs in this frontend-only slice.
An absent stepId means overview; it must not silently select the first step based on viewport width.
Prototype presentation never overrides real error, approval, decline, route, or repository permission behavior.
stop_condition: Stop if implementation needs any file outside the four allowed files, a new route/API/store/backend/dependency contract, YAML parsing, fixture data, or task 3.3 log/tab redesign.
